name: Malavi
notes: Janya of Harikambhoji (mela 28); sampurna and vakra — arohana S R G M P N M D N S, avarohana S N D N P M G M R S; a melody created by Tyagaraja, whose 'Nenarunchinanu' (Adi) is its sole exemplar and the source of its lakshana in the Sangraha Cudamani (its cittasvara is a later addition by Tirukkodikaval Krishna Iyer); jiva svaras Ri, Da and Ni. The name is a misnomer: Tulaja's Saramruta (c. 1732) records a melodically unrelated Malavi under mela 15 (Malavagaula), and that dead name was reassigned to Tyagaraja's mela-28 melody after 1850. Later contributors include Patnam Subramanya Iyer, Muthiah Bhagavatar, Jayachamaraja Wodeyar and GNB.
